purpose: Machine-readable mapping between the Closure Mathematics of Adaptive Dynamical Intelligence research reference and Aeon's implemented repository. Every extracted concept is classified with its implementation status, allowed use, prohibited interpretation, evidence file:line, test coverage, and claim boundary. The PDF is a research reference authored by Horizon Intelligence, Inc.; it is NOT automatically authoritative over the repository. The repository at 447f0dc (dual-clock evidence at 7b460e5, corrected spec at bc371e3, immutability test at dc0b439) is the authority on Aeon's implemented architecture.

reference.title: Closure: Mathematics of Adaptive Dynamical Intelligence
reference.subtitle: From linear operators to coupled recursion, reflexive dynamics, invariance, and operational closure
reference.author: Horizon Intelligence, Inc.
canonical_claim_boundary_quotes: Chapters 0 through 7 rely primarily on standard mathematics from linear algebra, dynamical systems, control, and adaptive systems.
Chapters 8 and 9 define autonomy and agency operationally; these definitions are useful but not unique across science.
The AEON translation is a proposed research program, not evidence that the architecture already possesses autonomy, agency, consciousness, or understanding.

i.meaning: token position inside a K-window w
i.note: bookkeeping index over the FAST CLOCK's per-token cadence

w.note: bookkeeping index over the SLOW CLOCK's window cadence

k.note: index over approved offline optimizer updates; applied outside the forward path; never appears during inference

fast_clock.cadence: one substrate.step per input token inside each K-window

slow_clock.cadence: one recursion.step per K-window; K = 16 immutable

dual_clock_collision_prohibition.prohibited_mapping: Aeon slow clock = parameter update theta_{tau+1} = G(theta_tau, S_tau)
dual_clock_collision_prohibition.why_prohibited: The PDF Chapter 10 generic model theta_{tau+1} = G(theta_tau, S_tau) is a general adaptive-system model. Aeon's implemented slow clock is a RecursionJoiner state tick, NOT a parameter update. Binding the PDF's slow theta-update to Aeon's implemented slow RecursionJoiner clock would mean claiming Aeon performs online parameter updates during inference, which the repository does not implement and which the correction order explicitly forbids for this tranche.
dual_clock_collision_prohibition.spec_binding: docs/en_train/EN_TRAIN_CORRECTED_MATHEMATICAL_SPEC.md Section 3 and the new closure section

descriptive_joint_state_only.meaning: The PDF's Chapter 7 augmented state z = (h, m, theta, c, phase, summary) is written for the repository as a DESCRIPTIVE joint-state view. It does not introduce runtime variables or update rules.

descriptive_mapping.expression: z_{k,w,i} = (substrate_state_{w,i}, h_w, c_w, theta_k, phase_i, window_summary_w, existing_stability_diagnostics)

components_bound_to_repo.substrate_state_{w,i}: state field of MatrixCell/VectorCell after fast tick i in window w (aeon/hybrid.py:156)
components_bound_to_repo.h_w, c_w: RecursionJoiner state after slow tick w (aeon/hybrid.py:175-177)
components_bound_to_repo.theta_k: HybridModel.parameters() at optimizer step k; only changes during authorized offline training (aeon/en_train/trainer.py:148)

MUST_NOT_claim: operational closure of Aeon in the PDF's Chapter 7-8 sense
autonomy in the PDF's Chapter 8 sense
agency in the PDF's Chapter 9 sense

three_rates_distinction.note: PDF Section 10.5 explicitly states 'three rates, not necessarily three clocks' and that the third rate 'need not be implemented as an independent clock' and 'event-triggered regulation often matches the mathematics better than arbitrary periodic checking'.

rates.aeon_binding_offline_learning: authorized offline optimizer step k (aeon/en_train/trainer.py:148); runs only during training, never during inference
rates.aeon_binding_viability_evaluation: aeon.en_train.proof.assert_architecture_invariant + assert_native_stability_gate + sigma_certificate; called at learning-curve gates (aeon/en_train/trainer.py:381-397)
rates.must_not_add: any periodic architectural clock for this rate; event-triggered or gate-triggered checks only

pdf_concepts.concept: State sufficiency — histories mapped to the same hidden state must be equivalent for future tasks
pdf_concepts.expression: x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t); z_t = (x_t, x_{t-1}, ..., x_{t-k}) restores deterministic sufficiency when a finite history is enough
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon's forward reinitializes substrate + recursion state every call (aeon/hybrid.py:141-142). State sufficiency across calls is provided by deterministic session-history replay in aeon/desktop/runtime.py (Policy B).
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: existing repository pattern; no change

pdf_concepts.concept: Recursion is not automatically learning
pdf_concepts.expression: A network that freezes parameters after training is dynamically recursive during inference but not parameter-reflexive.
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon inference: parameters frozen; recursion + substrate state evolve per session but theta remains fixed (witnessed by tests/test_desktop_inference_immutability.py).
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: spec Section 3.7 and Closure Integration Section 4 use this quote to distinguish recurrent-state evolution from parameter learning
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do NOT read Aeon's recursion.step as parameter learning; it is state evolution only.

pdf_concepts.concept: Learning is retained capability change
pdf_concepts.expression: 'Experience produces a retained change that improves a specified capability or objective.'
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon EN-TRAIN offline update theta_{k+1} = G_existing(theta_k, g_bar_k, q_k) at aeon/en_train/trainer.py:148; retention witnessed by candidate checkpoint (aeon/en_train/trainer.py:185-229) and weight-delta report (aeon/en_train/trainer.py:421-435).
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: EN-TRAIN learning is offline, gated, and stored in a candidate checkpoint distinct from P2

pdf_concepts.concept: Reflexivity — system's operation changes future operating rule
pdf_concepts.expression: h_{t+1} = F_{theta_t}(h_t, x_t); theta_{t+1} = G(theta_t, h_t, x_t, o_t)
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: NOT IMPLEMENTED in the runtime. During inference, theta is fixed. During authorized offline training, theta_{k+1} != theta_k but k is not a clock and does not run inside the forward path.
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: may be described as a proposed research program in docs; may NOT be implemented in this tranche
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: The PDF's slow theta-update MUST NOT be bound to Aeon's slow RecursionJoiner clock

pdf_concepts.concept: Fast weights, slow weights, hypernetworks, neuromodulatory states, online system identification
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: None of these mechanisms exist in aeon/*
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: may be described in research notes as future candidates (PDF Chapter 13.3 lists ordered-by-verification-difficulty candidates)
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do not implement in the current EN-TRAIN tranche

pdf_concepts.concept: Boundedness, stability, invariance, robustness are DIFFERENT
pdf_concepts.expression: 'Boundedness / Stability / Invariance / Robustness must be measured separately.'
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon separates these: finite-parameter check (aeon/en_train/proof.py:219-226), sigma-certificate (aeon/en_train/proof.py:229-237), architecture invariant (aeon/en_train/proof.py:65-80), and native stability gate (aeon/en_train/proof.py:240-261).
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: existing repository pattern; the spec now cites this PDF principle as motivation for the separation
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do NOT collapse them into a single scalar 'stability' number

pdf_concepts.concept: Parameter updates may require projection into an admissible set
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Partial. Aeon uses parameterization-by-construction for the sigma certificate (W_h = sigmoid(s_h)*MARGIN_H*Cayley(A_h)*diag(tanh(d_h)) at aeon/recursion.py:22-23) rather than explicit projection. Gradient clipping bounds ||g||_2 (aeon/en_train/trainer.py:117-127) but is not a projection onto an admissible set.
pdf_concepts.drift_note: The repository parameterization-by-construction achieves the PDF's admissibility goal without an explicit projection step. The spec now records this equivalence explicitly.
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: existing repository mechanism; the spec adds a cross-reference to PDF 6.5
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do NOT add a runtime projection step; existing parameterization is sufficient

pdf_concepts.concept: A penalty does not guarantee a hard constraint
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: The sigma certificate is a hard construction-time bound, not a soft penalty (aeon/recursion.py:22-23). No penalty term is used for stability; the certificate is a hard structural guarantee. This is the correct PDF-6.5 pattern.
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: existing pattern
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do NOT weaken the sigma certificate into a penalty

pdf_concepts.concept: Closure = complete declared joint-state description, NOT isolation
pdf_concepts.expression: z_t = (h_t, m_t, theta_t, c_t); z_{t+1} = Psi(z_t, x_t)
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon does not implement operational closure. This tranche writes a DESCRIPTIVE joint-state view only (see descriptive_joint_state_only above).
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: used in the spec as documentation of what Aeon's endogenous state currently consists of
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do NOT claim Aeon has operational closure, autonomy, agency, consciousness, or general intelligence

pdf_concepts.concept: No hidden oracle may perform correction
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon's runtime is offline_only and has no external correction path (aeon/desktop/runtime.py). Tests: tests/test_desktop_6_7_8.py::test_desktop_modules_have_no_outbound_network_reference; tests/test_desktop_6_7_8.py::test_bundle_manifest_declares_offline_only_policy.
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: existing pattern

pdf_concepts.concept: External inputs are allowed but must not supply the system's organization
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: User prompts are inputs but do not modify Aeon's organization (parameters). Witnessed by tests/test_desktop_inference_immutability.py.

pdf_concepts.concept: Apparent seams may indicate missing state
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Documentation observation only. No implementation change.

pdf_concepts.concept: Multiscale dual-clock formulation h_{t+1} = F_{theta_tau}(h_t, x_t); theta_{tau+1} = G(theta_tau, S_tau)
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon has an implemented dual clock (fast=substrate, slow=RecursionJoiner state tick), but Aeon's slow clock is a STATE tick, NOT a parameter update. Binding the PDF's slow theta-update to Aeon's slow clock is prohibited (see dual_clock_collision_prohibition).
pdf_concepts.drift_note: The PDF's dual-clock 'shape' matches Aeon's implemented dual-clock topology at the abstract level, but the slow-clock's semantic content is different (state vs parameters).
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: spec cites the PDF as showing that Aeon's implemented pattern is a special case of the multiscale form; the theta-update is only applied outside the forward path at optimizer step k
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Aeon slow clock is NEVER a parameter-update clock

pdf_concepts.concept: Three rates, not necessarily three clocks; event-triggered viability checks
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon has fast + slow clocks (implemented). The third rate (offline learning + viability evaluation) is realized as: (a) authorized offline optimizer step k (aeon/en_train/trainer.py:148), and (b) evaluation-only viability gates called at learning-curve checkpoints (aeon/en_train/trainer.py:381-397).
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: spec formally binds this three-rate view to the repository
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do NOT add a periodic architectural clock for rate 3

pdf_concepts.concept: Aliasing between clocks; summary S_tau design
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon's window summary is s_w = s_proj(mean_i r_{w,i}) at aeon/hybrid.py:160-161. Mean-only aggregation is exactly the pattern PDF 10.3 warns can hide oscillation. This is a POTENTIAL research finding: PDF 10.3 recommends moments, quantiles, spectral energy, gradient stats, constraint violations, task-relevant memory probes.
pdf_concepts.implementation_status: implemented (mean-only) with a documented future-research consideration
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: spec records the PDF observation as a future research consideration; NOT implemented in this tranche
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do NOT change the aggregation path in this tranche

pdf_concepts.concept: Long-horizon sensitivity governed by Jacobian products; block Jacobian for augmented state
pdf_concepts.expression: partial z_T / partial z_t = product_{k=t}^{T-1} J_Psi(z_k); G_T = sigma_max(J_{T-1}...J_0)
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon does not currently implement a block-Jacobian audit. The sigma-certificate at aeon/recursion.py bounds per-step W_h/W_c norms only. Finite-horizon gain G_T is not measured.
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: spec records this as future evaluation-only research; no runtime change
pdf_concepts.prohibited_interpretation: Do NOT introduce a runtime block-Jacobian check in this tranche

pdf_concepts.concept: Local stability is not a global guarantee; product-of-stable-matrices can be unstable
pdf_concepts.pdf_location: Chapter 11.1 and Chapter 5.4, p.43 and p.24
pdf_concepts.repository_counterpart: Aeon's sigma certificate is a per-step bound. Cross-window switching is prevented by the fixed W_h, W_c during inference (theta immutable). The PDF concern applies to reflexive systems that Aeon is NOT.
pdf_concepts.allowed_use: spec cites this as the reason no adaptive operator is introduced in this tranche
